label: Mira Fenwick's first greeting — protection, not permission

purpose.value: Fenwick sells the hero good kit with bright patter and one hook in it: protective equipment is protection, not permission to invade another realm — nothing on her shelves is.

emotionalProgression.note: Best kit in the capital, fitted and flattered; the sales patter never quite covers the opinion.
Greaves are not a warrant. The word on the tag is 'protection'. The other purchase she does not stock.
He hears the warning as a merchant's blessing on the crusade; she completes the sale and quietly logs the coin as evidence against herself.

notes: Misunderstanding pair: her 'protection is not permission' is heard as 'even the merchants believe in me'. Deliberately NO required facts — the protection-is-not-permission truth has no canon fact id, so purpose text carries it. fact_law_of_fair_warning is the wrong register for her and is not used. Her contradiction: she sells anyway; her refusal line is weapons whose only purpose is killing. Never validate the hero's prophecy framing: there is no canon fact supporting 'the realms are evil', and that absence is itself the guard.
